summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gains a show_speed option (default off) and a static render_speed method, used in render() when the total is unknown. The track() helper gains show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column. Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables; the total stays None. Updated tests/test_progress.py: added test_task_progress_column_speed and removed the two ValueError assertions. Added a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased / Added. Nothing was run or committed; the tests still need to be run to confirm the expected values.
